content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I applied a custom font to some fields in the [product_name] web editor. It displays correctly in the preview, but after deployment, the browser substitutes the font. The SD card does not contain the font files required. Is this an issue with the [product_name] web editor?

analysis.insight_summary: A user notes that custom fonts look correct in the preview of the [product_name] web editor, but after deployment, the web interface uses a different font since the actual font files are missing from the SD card. This points to a possible problem in the deployment process with asset management or file transfer to the SD card.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want custom fonts to be included automatically during deployment, so the final web interface matches the intended design.
